svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, mirror images. Mark out on 6 mm steel plate; positions are

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the axle center (the middle of the slot's round end is 3 mm ahead).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outline: 82 long, from 30 behind to 52 ahead of the axle; 54 tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from 16 below to 38 above it. Saw and file; break every edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle slot 10 wide, open to the rear, round end 3 mm ahead of the axle:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 10 mm at the round end, saw the two sides, file parallel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eyelet: 5.5 mm hole 18 behind and 20 above the axle (rack and fender).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the chainstay end (40 ahead, 1 above the axle) and the seat stay

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end (16 ahead, 20 above) are slotted 6 mm and brazed over the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The inner faces sit 110 apart for the coaster hub. The axle slides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back in the slot to tension the chain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 3/8 in axle slides the length of the slot without binding.
